tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
📓 Codex: Dale taught Yuki Gossip Network.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Priya.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Davide speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Davide speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Davide speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 46 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The northwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the northwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
You accept Stonebridge's food — 2,562 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Yuki clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Davide speaks at The Bloodied's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
⛓️ Nina brings it home: The Red Table bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
🌾 Haven sends 1,500 kcal of grain to The Red Table's fire — not tribute, the other way around. Someone's grandmother over there will remember who fed her. (Trust +8.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🗣️ Cosimo to Sofia, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
You accept Stonebridge's food — 1,959 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Yuki clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from The Red Table turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)

◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

At the fire, someone does the math out loud — the pods' life-support draw, against the pantry. "I'm just saying. That power could be food." Nobody looks at the mourners. Everybody knows where the mourners are sitting.
(Defend the pods — it will cost real food — or let the question hang.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from The Red Table turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🗣️ Davide to Priya, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

◈ SYSTEM: "32. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
You accept Stonebridge's food — 2,681 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Yuki clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 3,343 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

🗣️ Cosimo to Davide, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/9/5), with 4 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 1 · Forage 20 · Craft 9 · Talk 18 · Explore 23)
◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: only 0 of 2 different wave-5 monsters faced; no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The time you stayed your hand. The table doesn't know what to do with it — which is its own kind of fear. Your people breathe.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.

You pledge it aloud, on the record: humanity's fear is a standing shield, never a sword. The table signs. Your people sleep. Somewhere the System files you under "deterrent, benevolent" and never quite understands the second word.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
